title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Position: Accounts Assistant
Job ID: (phone number removed)
Location: Poundbury, Dorset
Rate/Salary: £33,000 per annum
Type: Permanent / Full Time

HSB Technical Ltd is a specialist recruiter within the Power & Propulsion, Shipbuilding, Maritime Shipping, Energy, Subsea and Fire & Security sectors.

The job description below outlines the position of Accounts Assistant.

Overview:

Our client is looking for an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their finance team based in Poundbury.

The successful candidate will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, with responsibilities covering both purchase and sales ledger activities, invoice processing, supplier payments, account reconciliations and general financial administration.

This is a varied finance role, offering the opportunity to work closely with the wider finance team, project managers, suppliers and customers to ensure accurate financial records and efficient financial processes.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant position, with a good understanding of purchase and sales ledger processes. Experience using Sage accounting software and Microsoft Excel would be particularly beneficial.

Our client is looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger, Sales Ledger or similar finance role.
- Experience processing purchase invoices and customer sales invoices.
- Experience reconciling supplier accounts and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Working knowledge of Sage Accounts or Sage 200.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.
- The ability to manage workloads, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- The ability to work independently as well as effectively within a finance team.
- A proactive approach to resolving invoice queries and financial discrepancies.

Duties and Responsibilities
Purchase Ledger
- Receive, review and process supplier invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Match purchase invoices against purchase orders, goods received notes (GRNs) and supporting documentation.
- Obtain the appropriate authorisation for invoices where required.
- Process approved supplier invoices using Sage accounting software.
- Resolve invoice queries with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Prepare supplier payment runs and reconcile supplier accounts to ensure records remain accurate and up to date.

Financial Processing
- Process and reconcile company credit card transactions.
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
- Assist with month-end procedures and account reconciliations.

Sales Ledger Support
- Prepare and raise customer sales invoices.
- Work alongside Project Managers to ensure purchase orders are received promptly to avoid unnecessary delays to invoicing.
- Support receipt allocation and customer account administration.
- Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue accounts.
- Maintain accurate sales ledger records.

General Finance Support
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Assist with a variety of finance and administrative tasks as directed by the Finance team.
- Support the continuous improvement of finance processes and controls.
- Provide ad-hoc reporting and administrative assistance when required.
- Contribute to financial controls, audit activities and process improvement initiatives.

The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant to join an established organisation in a varied and hands-on finance position.

The role offers a starting salary of £33,000 per annum and the opportunity to develop your experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger and wider financial operations.

Candidates with previous experience using Sage and handling both purchase and sales ledger responsibilities are particularly encouraged to apply.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
BOOKKEEPER

ABOUT US

Flux Pumps International (UK) Ltd

Flux Pumps UK is a leading distributor of industrial pumps for emptying drums, containers and tanks. We are a wholly owned subsidiary of our parent company Flux-Gereate GmbH. Our Corporate headquarters and manufacturing facility is based near Stuttgart, in Germany.

FLUX has been manufacturing world leading pumps since 1950. Our products are designed for the longest service life in the toughest applications. We supply pumps and flow meters for almost any fluid water, oils, solvents, flammable liquids, food and pharmaceutical products. Our extensive range of products is suitable for transfer, emptying, mixing, filling and metering. Key industries served include manufacturing, surface finishing, paints, petrochemicals, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and water treatment.

The Flux range is centred on the class-leading F400 series barrel & IBC pumps. We also manufacture the CombiFlux battery operated container pump - the World's first battery powered chemical pump for industrial use. Other products include one-touch dispensing systems, hygienic pumps and Viscopower pumps for handling high viscosity fluids eg. tomato paste or cosmetic cream.

Flux UK is a dynamic, sales focussed business - we do our utmost to provide industry leading customer service. As a result, our business has grown impressively over the past 10 years. Please check the customer feedback on our website.

The Role

Due to an internal promotion, we have an exciting opportunity for a Bookkeeper to join our small, friendly team. The role is an office-based position working alongside our operations team and reporting to the UK Director. The role requires at least 5 years book-keeping experience (experience with Sage accounting software is essential) and ideally basic knowledge of UK GAAP.

Remote working is not permitted for this role.

Sales Ledger
- Creating sales invoices from shipping documents and e-mailing to customers

- Matching stock receipts to purchase invoices for stock items
- Compiling a monthly suppliers payment list

Office Administration

- Any other ad hoc duties that may be required

Working Hours

9 30 Mon-Thurs with 30 minutes for lunch (24 hours per week). Alternative working patterns may be considered.

Working Environment

The role is based at our Verwood office.

Training

The candidate will receive training on our ProAlpha ERP system.

Benefits

Competitive salary.

The Company operates a contributory pension scheme (6% company contribution).

22 days holiday (increasing by 1 extra day with every 2 years service, to a maximum of 25 days).

To apply

Please e-mail CV and covering letter explaining your suitability for the role.

Start date: ASAP

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: up to £15.50 per hour (depending on experience)

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking

Schedule:
- Part-time Monday to Thursday

Education/ Qualifications / Experience required:
- Minimum 5 years experience in Bookkeeping is essential
- Experience with Sage accounting software is essential
- Ideally AAT Level 2 Certificate in Bookkeeping, or equivalent
- A Levels or equivalent
- GCSE s

Licence / Certification:

The organisation offers a flexible approach to hybrid working, alongside a strong focus on learning, development, wellbeing and creating an inclusive working environment where people can be themselves.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining an established and successful organisation with a varied portfolio. Working from attractive offices near Christchurch, you will be part of a welcoming finance team that supports several different areas of the wider organisation.
Your new role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will manage the everyday purchase ledger process and help ensure supplier accounts remain accurate and up to date. This will include entering and coding invoices and credit notes, checking documentation processed through automated software and completing supplier statement reconciliations.
You will investigate invoice discrepancies, respond to supplier queries and work closely with colleagues across the organisation to resolve any issues. You will also assist with regular payment runs, arrange additional electronic payments when needed and provide general support to the wider finance team.

What you'll need to succeed
You will have previous purchase ledger or accounts payable experience and be confident managing a busy workload accurately. A practical knowledge of VAT is important, alongside strong attention to detail and good communication skills. You will be comfortable using accounting software and Excel. A dependable, organised and team-focused approach will be key.

What you'll get in return
You will receive a salary of 26,000- 29,000 depending on experience, 22 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a 6% employer pension contribution. Free on-site parking is available, and you will work in a pleasant office environment as part of a supportive finance team. This is a fully office-based position with no hybrid working.
